finding: BuildingOperationStep claimed nearest reserve selection but evaluated promotion in roster order. An earlier farther candidate could spend the sole callback cover VIEW ray before a nearer established observer was evaluated.
implementation: Rank the existing rotating maximum16 candidate window by distance to survivor/building and stable window index before calling promotion; first candidate with actual promotion proof wins.
authority: Existing sole-exit-cover protection, one shared VIEW ray, current proof revalidation, native actor tasks, exact episode and original deadline unchanged.
cost: Sort at most16 tuples per casualty slot; no new query or worker. Runtime not measured.
limits: Nearest within current rotating window and available proof budget only; no shortest-route or physical arrival guarantee. Source intent is continuity of the surviving CQB pair, not copying unbounded upstream pair workers.
validation: Existing promotion tests extended; full build and independent candidate results recorded in handover.
